title: Finite linear dual dimensions and ranks of dual maps
statement: Let $k$ be a field [def-weil-field], let $V,W$ be finite-dimensional $k$-vector spaces [def-weil-finite-dimensional-subspace], and let $f:V\to W$ be $k$-linear. Put $V^*=\operatorname{Hom}_k(V,k)$ and $W^*=\operatorname{Hom}_k(W,k)$, and define $f^*:W^*\to V^*$ by $f^*(\lambda)=\lambda\circ f$. Both dual spaces are finite-dimensional, and $\dim_kV^*=\dim_kV$ and $\dim_kW^*=\dim_kW$ [def-weil-vector-space-dimension]. Moreover $\dim_k\operatorname{im}(f^*)=\dim_k\operatorname{im}(f)$.
